description.value: Amato Gelato & Cafè is a classic Italian gelato shop in Vancouver's Mount Pleasant neighbourhood, carrying on over 85 years of family tradition through the Mario's Gelati lineage. The shop rotates over 72 flavours of authentic Italian gelato and sorbetti made from traditional family recipes using locally sourced BC fruits and dairy. It serves as the public retail storefront for the Mario's Gelati wholesale brand, making it a Vancouver institution for handcrafted Italian frozen desserts.
